thread:
liz: Quick check: Mosaic Interop webinar confirmed May 14 at 11:00am PT. Need final speaker roster, demo fallbacks, and a swag customs plan by EOD Friday.
jamal: Got it. I'll own speaker collection. Please DM names + titles to me by Thu noon.
kai: AV booked. We'll do a simultaneous stream to APAC. Requesting a 2-minute pre-recorded fallback from each partner for local time issues.
maria: Marketing needs 200x200 headshots, 1-line bios, SVG logos, and the final CTA copy (50 chars max) by close of business Friday. Also short landing URL preferred.
sam-cloudleap: CloudLeap confirms Samir (evangelist) + Anya (solutions). We'll send logos and a 1-line blurb tonight.
jun-pixel: PixelCompute will provide a 90s perf clip and a 40s failover clip showing fallback to quantized CPU. Uploading Wed EOD.
oliver: Swag deadlines: domestic cutoff May 7, EU cutoff May 1. If partners ship to SF pallet, courier picks up May 6. Please include partner contact on customs forms.
jamal: Redwood initial counts: 150 US / 40 EU / 25 APAC. For APAC we suggest QR-only to reduce customs friction. Partners, please confirm your allocation.
maria: QR-only for APAC OK. US/EU packs: sticker sheet + promo decal + postcard with two promo codes. We can include one partner insert if approved.
liz: Run-of-show proposal: 10:50 tech check; 11:00 host intro (liz) 3m; 11:03 CloudLeap keynote 10m; 11:13 PixelCompute demo (clip + live) 8m; 11:21 Redwood deep dive 8m; 11:29 Panel + live Qs 18m; 11:47 CTA + marketplace reveal 6m. Keep Redwood deep dive to 8m to protect Q&A time.
kai: Can we add a 2m moderator handoff buffer and a 1m slide swap buffer? I'll pad the schedule. Also scheduling dry run May 12 9:00-9:30am PT.
jamie: I'll moderate. Drafting 5 prep questions and the panel order; sharing by Thu morning.
sam-cloudleap: One request: show CloudLeap marketplace tile during CTA with a pricing toggle (annual vs pay-as-you-go) if possible. We'll sign off on copy.
jun-pixel: Note for demo ops: include a visible failover banner when the quantized CPU path is used so viewers see graceful degradation. We'll supply the overlay graphic.
deploy-bot: Event page created: https://dashboard.redwood/events/mosaic-interop-webinar  please review and add any missing metadata.
maria: I'll run a tweet thread at CTA time. Need approved marketplace blurb + shortened URL by Fri. Also need partner-approved follow-up blurbs for the 24h email.
jamal: I'll coordinate courier addresses with Oliver and upload speaker assets Thu noon.
oliver: Logistics: mark packages "Mosaic Interop / Redwood" and include HS code on EU shipments. DM fulfillment@redwood-internal.com with ship addresses.
liz: Final checklist: speaker names, headshots, bios, marketplace blurb, pre-recorded clips, courier addresses, partner follow-up blurbs. This thread is the single source of truth; ping me if anything slips. :thumbsup:
